answer: Make each identity post refundable collateral into a shared vault that only unlocks slowly as established peers attest to a long history of honest work. A clone fleet cannot cheaply fake that record: every alias must sink fresh capital and wait out its own vesting window, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds and a thousand waits. Reputation drifts in like a steady zephyr, never a cheap trick, and a well-crafted sonnet of claims earns nothing until the vault confirms the stake behind it.
